raw_segments.text: They want to see the views of Dublin from the top of Nelson's pillar.
They save up three and tenpence in a red-tin letterbox money box.
They shake out the three penny bits in sixpences and coax out the pennies with the blade
Two and three in silver and one in seven in coppers.
They put on their bonnets and best clothes and take their umbrellas for fear it may come
